'''Vatri Kulan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Republic Army]]. During the [[Galactic War]], she was stationed at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Outpost Cresh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vatri appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Republic players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" /> The ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', released alongside the game, identified her as "Vatri Kulan."
